title: Theology of the Trinity: one God in three persons
english: In the theology of the Trinity, one God is glorified and worshipped in three persons: one divinity, one nature, one essence, one power and authority, one will. Yet there are three persons and three hypostases, each with its own property. For the Father's property is to be unbegotten; the Son's property is to be begotten; and the Holy Spirit's property is to be proceeding.
